name: tr-corporate-income-tax
description: Turkish corporate income tax (kurumlar vergisi) for tax year 2026 under the Corporate Tax Law no. 5520 (KVK), Covers full and limited liability, the 25% rate and the 30% financial-sector rate, the export (5 points) and manufacturing (1 point in 2026, 12.5% from 2027) reductions, the 95% deductions for foreign trading and qualified service centres (Law 7582), the 10% domestic minimum corporate tax from 2025, the Pillar Two 15% domestic and global top-up taxes for groups over EUR 750 million, the taxable base, participation exemptions, five-year losses, thin capitalisation, the suspension of inflation accounting to 2027, quarterly provisional tax, the annual return in the fourth month, withholding on payments to non-residents, penalties and interest. Trigger on: kurumlar vergisi, Turkish corporate tax, yurt içi asgari kurumlar vergisi, geçici vergi, iştirak kazancı istisnası, Pillar Two Türkiye. Out of scope: transfer pricing documentation, individuals (turkey-pit), VAT (turkey-vat), pay
